settings.desc: Manage qBittorrent session and global parameters.

all.title: All qBittorrent Preferences
all.desc: Shows every server setting on a dedicated functional category page. Names and choices follow qBittorrent's official localization.
all.warning: Changing the WebUI address, port, authentication, HTTPS, proxy, or alternative UI path may immediately interrupt this connection. Keep another recovery path available before saving.
all.critical_changes: Includes WebUI or proxy settings that may interrupt the connection.
all.save_failed_desc: A WebUI or network change may have interrupted the connection. Check qBittorrent.

category_descriptions.speed: Global and alternative rate limits, schedules, and transport protocols.
category_descriptions.advanced: Disk I/O, cache, memory, sockets, and version-specific settings.

creator.description: Create a .torrent file from a file or folder already available to the qBittorrent server.
creator.start_seeding_desc: Add the result to the current qBittorrent instance

interface_settings.warning: Importing may change WebUI, network, or authentication settings. Only use a trusted backup from the same server.

auth.connect_desc: Connects directly to the qBittorrent Web API on desktop and mobile.
auth.session_hint: Existing qBittorrent sessions are detected automatically.
